question: Who has been appointed as the Director of the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB)? (Sep 2024)
solution: The correct answer is Alok Ranjan [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • ** Alok Ranjan, a 1991-batch IPS officer from Madhya Pradesh cadre, appointed as Director of the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) until June 30, 2026.**
